verdict.rationale: Missive documents that it connects to IMAP and SMTP mail servers, including ones with untrusted certificates, and to Gmail with full two-way sync. That means mail remains on the user's own standards-based servers rather than being held only inside Missive. There is no evidence that Missive itself offers standards-based export (mbox/EML), JMAP support, or protocol access to Missive-held data such as team comments and chats. missing for 10: standards-based export (mbox/EML), JMAP support, explicit documentation that mail stays fully reachable outside Missive, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in

citations.quote: Connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP email accounts to Missive.
Connect to mail servers with untrusted certificates. When an IMAP or SMTP server's certificate is self-signed, expired
Connect Gmail or Google Workspace to Missive. Full two-way sync with labels.
